text: a WHO recommends a single intramuscular dose of spectinomy- cin 25 mg/kg (maximum 75 mg) as an alternative to ceftriaxone. The CDC recommends spectinomycin as an alternative to cepha- losporins in the treatment of uncomplicated gonorrhoea (p.191) in children beyond the newborn period and weighing under 45 kg; a single intramuscular dose equivalent to 40 mg/kg of spectinomycin may be given. Preparations USP 31: Spectinomycin for Injectable Suspension.
